findings.description: retryable=False contradicted the comment describing the retry policy; the comment was aligned with the no-same-call-retry policy.
The idle timeout relies on private urllib internals (response.fp.raw._sock), which are not part of any documented API and may be absent or behave differently across Python versions.
The 900s idle timeout exceeds the effective API timeout cap (600s) for backends using the default timeout, so the idle timeout never fires on those paths.
The error message reports the 900s constant even when the socket timeout was clamped to a shorter remaining deadline, misleading operators.
Exceptions from sock.settimeout() are silently swallowed, so a rejected timeout setting degrades the idle bound without any warning.
